basics.description:
**EasyVista ITSM Integration for Microsoft Sentinel**

Deploys a complete bidirectional integration between Microsoft Sentinel and EasyVista ITSM including:
- 6 Logic App playbooks for automated ticket lifecycle management
- 5 analytic rules for ITSM-based threat detection
- 5 hunting queries for proactive investigation
- 1 CISO Dashboard workbook with 6 operational tabs
- Content Hub solution metadata

basics.name: workspace
basics.toolTip: The Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is deployed

basics.name: workspaceDropdown
basics.label: Sentinel Workspace
basics.toolTip: Select the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is deployed

options.text: Provide your EasyVista ITSM API connection details. You need a Bearer token with access to the REST API v1.

elements.name: EasyVistaHost
elements.label: EasyVista Server Host
elements.toolTip: The hostname of your EasyVista server (without https:// prefix)

constraints.validationMessage: Please enter the EasyVista server hostname

elements.name: EasyVistaAccount
elements.label: EasyVista Account ID
elements.toolTip: The EasyVista account identifier used in API paths

constraints.validationMessage: Please enter the EasyVista account ID

elements.name: EasyVistaBearerToken
elements.toolTip: The Bearer token for authenticating to the EasyVista REST API

options.text: Choose which components to deploy. Analytic rules and hunting queries are always deployed.

elements.name: deployPlaybooks
elements.label: Deploy Logic App Playbooks (6 playbooks for bidirectional integration)
elements.toolTip: Deploys 6 Logic App playbooks: CreateIncident, UpdateTicketStatus, GetTicketInfo, TriggerResponseActions, SyncStatusToSentinel, CloseTicket

elements.name: deployWorkbook
elements.label: Deploy CISO Dashboard Workbook
elements.toolTip: Deploys the CISO Dashboard workbook with 6 tabs: Executive Summary, Ticket Operations, SLA & Performance, Sync Health, Response Actions, Asset & Employee Intel

options.text: The TriggerResponseActions playbook requires Microsoft Defender for Endpoint API access to execute isolation, process termination, and file quarantine actions from EasyVista. Leave blank to skip MDE integration.

elements.name: MDEClientId
elements.label: MDE App Registration Client ID
elements.toolTip: Azure AD App Registration Client ID with MDE Machine.Isolate and Machine.StopAndQuarantineFile permissions

elements.name: MDEClientSecret
elements.toolTip: Client Secret for the Azure AD App Registration
